title: Grade 2 Science — Tue, May 19
description: Plants Around Us — Day 2 of 5: Types of plants and what they need
subject: science

questions.question: A banana plant is a:
questions.explanation: A banana plant is a tree — it is tall and has a thick stem. Even though it looks soft, it counts as a tree in classification.

questions.question: Which plant creeps on the ground?
questions.explanation: Pumpkin is a creeper — its stem is weak and it grows along the ground.

questions.question: Which of these is an herb?
questions.explanation: Tulsi (Holy Basil) is an herb — it is small and soft with a green stem. Other herbs: mint, coriander, spinach.

questions.question: What does a plant use sunlight for?
questions.explanation: Plants use sunlight to make food in their leaves. This process needs sunlight, water, and air.

questions.question: Which plant has a very thick stem that stores water?
questions.explanation: Cactus stores water in its thick green stem. It lives in deserts where there is little rain.

questions.question: The lotus is a plant that grows in:
questions.explanation: Lotus is a water plant. It grows in ponds and lakes with its roots in the mud and flowers on the water surface.

questions.question: Which tree has roots hanging from its branches?
questions.explanation: The banyan tree has prop roots that hang down from its branches and grow into the ground. It can become very wide.

questions.question: Which of these plants has thorns?
questions.explanation: Cactus has thorns (sharp spines) instead of leaves. The thorns help protect the plant from animals.

questions.question: What happens if a plant does not get enough water?
questions.explanation: Without water, a plant wilts (droops) and may die. Water is essential for plants to stay stiff and make food.

questions.question: Which plant do we use to make rope and mats?
questions.explanation: Coconut plant is very useful — its leaves, trunk, and fibre are all used. Coir (from coconut shell) is used to make ropes and mats.

questions.question: How are shrubs different from trees?
options: Shrubs are smaller with branches near the base; trees are taller with one main trunk
questions.explanation: Shrubs are medium-sized with multiple branches from near the ground. Trees are taller with one thick main trunk.

questions.question: Which of these is a climber plant?
questions.explanation: Money plant is a climber — it climbs walls and poles using its stem. Other climbers: grape vine, pea plant.

questions.question: The neem tree is used for:
questions.explanation: Neem is a very useful tree. Its leaves, bark, and twigs are used for medicine. Neem twigs are used for brushing teeth.

questions.question: Which gas do plants take in from the air to make food?
questions.explanation: Plants take in carbon dioxide (CO₂) from the air. Combined with water and sunlight, they make sugar (food) and release oxygen.

questions.question: Forests are important because:
options: They give us clean air, water, and are home to animals
questions.explanation: Forests give us clean air (trees release oxygen), prevent floods, provide habitat for animals, and give us wood, fruits, and medicines.
